# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection discussed alters the sign of just one pion field, leading to a relative phase difference of π compared to references [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is created by changing the sign of all three pion fields.
- The definition employed in this paper allows for a more intuitive comparison with a similar scenario involving monopoles, as outlined in equation (3.10).
- The profile function reaches zero at a distance of s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, ensuring a continuous patching together of the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion, with fields outside each core set to the vacuum.
- Besides initial conditions derived from the simple ansatz (3.7), more complex initial conditions based on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map were also utilized.
